answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT q0 to q1, CNOT q1 to q2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. The job ID is 01a15f39-dccd-73ed-afc1-39020486860e. The counts were {"000": 200}. The mock backend is free and does not simulate the physics. That is why it returned all zeros and not the roughly 50/50 split of 000 and 111 that a real GHZ state gives.
